title: Kaveri Mithai Stores · betting via Telegram-shared UPI link, no website
description: SYNTHETIC. A sweet shop whose UPI link is shared in Telegram betting groups. No website or crawler hit, no match calendar, no refunds, no onward payouts, one stable settlement account. Five depositors top up about ten times a week. Expected: case opened on amounts, payer geography, repeat depositors and joint off-profile cluster, without any crawler evidence.
